title: Getting Started with Code & Coffee Philadelphia
description: Everything you need to know about joining our vibrant tech community in Philadelphia.
content: Welcome to Code & Coffee Philadelphia! Whether you're a seasoned developer, a designer, or someone just starting their tech journey, our community has something for everyone.
author: Code & Coffee Team

title: Building Your First REST API with Node.js and Express
description: A beginner-friendly guide to creating a REST API using Node.js and Express framework with practical examples.
content: Building REST APIs is a fundamental skill for modern web developers. In this tutorial, we'll create a complete REST API using Node.js and Express, perfect for beginners who want to understand backend development.
author: Alex Johnson

title: Philly Tech Week Innovation Hackathon 2025
description: Recap of our successful Philly Tech Week hackathon featuring AI, generative gaming, and startup-oriented projects.
content: Our Philly Tech Week Innovation Hackathon 2025 was an incredible success! Over three days, developers, designers, and entrepreneurs came together to build innovative solutions and push the boundaries of technology.
author: Code & Coffee Team

title: Project Request
description: Got a coding challenge you're stuck on? Working on an exciting project that could use some extra hands? Code & Coffee Philadelphia is here to help!
content: Got a coding challenge you're stuck on? Working on an exciting project that could use some extra hands? Code & Coffee Philadelphia is here to help! Our community is full of talented developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts who love collaborating and sharing knowledge.

title: Tech Talent Matchboard

content: Looking to connect with talented developers, designers, and tech professionals in Philadelphia? Or maybe you're seeking new opportunities in the local tech scene? Our Tech Talent Matchboard is designed to bring together the best minds in Philly's growing technology ecosystem.
